02 / Services

What I can
help with.

Pick a service to see more. Have something that isn't listed? Call and ask. If it's around the house, there's a good chance it's on the list.

  • Repairs, upgrades and the projects that keep slipping down your list. I look after your whole property, big jobs and small ones alike.

  • Get your home looking good as new. I use high-quality equipment and work quickly and professionally, so you get a clean finish without the job dragging on. One room or the whole house.

  • Getting walls ready for a fresh finish. Drywall work pairs naturally with painting, so the whole room can be finished by one person.

  • The finishing details that make a room look done: trim work measured, cut and fitted neatly.
